store_types.Name: AwsSecretsManager

Properties.Name: UseEC2AssumeRole
Properties.DisplayName: Assume new Account / Role in EC2
Properties.Description: A switch to enable the store to assume a new Account ID and Role when using EC2 credentials

Properties.Name: UseOAuth
Properties.Description: A switch to enable the store to use an OAuth provider workflow to authenticate with AWS ACM

Properties.Name: UseIAM
Properties.Description: A switch to enable the store to use IAM User auth to assume a role when authenticating with AWS ACM

Properties.Name: EC2AssumeRole
Properties.Description: The AWS Role to assume using the EC2 instance credentials

Properties.Name: OAuthScope
Properties.Description: This is the OAuth Scope needed for Okta OAuth, defined in Okta

Properties.Name: OAuthGrantType
Properties.Description: In OAuth 2.0, the term 'grant type' refers to the way an application gets an access token. In Okta this is `client_credentials`

Properties.Name: OAuthUrl
Properties.Description: An optional parameter sts:ExternalId to pass with Assume Role calls

Properties.Name: IAMAssumeRole
Properties.Description: The AWS Role to assume as the IAM User.

Properties.Name: OAuthAssumeRole
Properties.Description: The AWS Role to assume after getting an OAuth token.

Properties.Name: ExternalId
Properties.Description: An optional parameter sts:ExternalId to pass with Assume Role calls

Properties.Name: ServerUsername
Properties.Description: The AWS Access Key for an IAM User or Client ID for OAuth. Depends on Auth method in use.

Properties.Name: ServerPassword
Properties.Description: The AWS Access Secret for an IAM User or Client Secret for OAuth. Depends on Auth method in use.

EntryParameters.Name: CertificateTags
EntryParameters.Description: If desired, tags can be applied to the certificate entries in AWS Secrets Manager.  Provide them as a JSON string of key-value pairs ie: '{'tag-name': 'tag-content', 'other-tag-name': 'other-tag-content'}'

EntryParameters.Name: ReplicaRegions
EntryParameters.Description: To have the certificate replicated to other regions, you can provide them here as a JSON array in the format: [{ 'KmsKeyId': '<optionally specify the encryption key ID', 'Region': '<region name>'}, {...}]

store_types.StorePathDescription: The store path is an arbitrary identifier that will be set as a tag on the certificates in order to logically group them.  The tag will be in the following format: {'KeyfactorCertificateStore': '<store path>'}

description: This orchestrator extension allows managing Certificates stored in AWS Secrets Manager
name: Integration Template
